generator.params.bloom_years.note: The Woody Plant Seed Manual's Cornus chapter: the flowers are borne in terminal clusters, at the ends of the twigs, so only a twig's newest short shoots flower. Every short shoot flowering all its life packed a Pacific dogwood's shoots with overlapping heads along their length; flowering only in its first year leaves separate heads near the shoot tips, as photographs show (Imagekit count trial, 2026-10-19).

generator.params.blooms.note: The Woody Plant Seed Manual's Cornus chapter: the flowers are borne in terminal clusters (a head inside showy bracts in the flowering and Pacific dogwoods, a flat-topped cyme in red-osier), one to a flowering shoot, so a short shoot bears one bloom. Two to a shoot packed a Pacific dogwood's every shoot with overlapping heads where photos show separate heads at the shoot tips (Imagekit count trial, 2026-10-19).

traits.flowering_position.note: The Woody Plant Seed Manual's Cornus chapter (read in full): the flowers are borne in terminal clusters, in the flowering and Pacific dogwoods inside showy bracts; FEIS's Cornus sericea review (page read): a terminal, flat-topped cyme.
